books.title: O Jardim das Aflições
books.author: Olavo de Carvalho
books.query: O Jardim das Aflições Olavo de Carvalho livro
books.description: An essay in philosophy and cultural criticism in which the author links materialism, civil religion and the history of Western ideas. The goal is to meet the thesis directly in the text.
books.question: How does the author interpret the relationships between culture, power and spirituality?
books.whyRead: To follow the author's interpretation of culture and spirituality firsthand, identifying his sources, arguments and points of contention before forming an opinion.

books.title: A Nova Era e a Revolução Cultural
books.author: Olavo de Carvalho
books.query: A Nova Era e a Revolução Cultural Olavo de Carvalho livro
books.description: A critical analysis of Fritjof Capra and Antonio Gramsci, focused on the links the author draws between intellectual currents, culture and politics.
books.question: How can philosophical ideas shape cultural disputes?
books.whyRead: To understand how the author connects philosophical debates and cultural disputes, and to assess, alongside other readings, the connections he proposes.

books.title: O Imbecil Coletivo
books.author: Olavo de Carvalho
books.query: O Imbecil Coletivo Olavo de Carvalho livro
books.description: A collection of critiques and controversies about Brazilian intellectual life. It is a work of cultural intervention, with the author's own assessments and arguments.
books.question: What criteria should we use to evaluate public debate?
books.whyRead: To get to know a polemical intervention in Brazilian intellectual debate and reflect on the quality of the arguments, the role of criticism and its limits.

books.title: Do Reino e Outros Escritos
books.author: São Tomás de Aquino
books.query: Do Reino e Outros Escritos São Tomás de Aquino livro
books.description: Texts of medieval political philosophy on government, the common good, legitimacy and tyranny. The edition may include other writings besides the treatise Do Reino.
books.question: What defines a government oriented toward the common good?
books.whyRead: To examine, through a classic text, the common good, the ruler's virtues and the limits of power, themes that remain present in political discussion.

books.title: Suma Teológica
books.author: São Tomás de Aquino
books.query: Suma Teológica Santo Tomás de Aquino livro volume
books.description: A vast work of scholastic theology and philosophy. Its themes include virtue, justice, law, reason and faith; check which volume the edition includes.
books.question: How does Thomas Aquinas connect law, virtue and justice?
books.whyRead: To have a reference work in philosophy and theology on reason, faith, virtue and justice. It is a study text, especially useful if you choose the volume carefully.

books.title: O Ente e a Essência
books.author: São Tomás de Aquino
books.query: O Ente e a Essência Santo Tomás de Aquino livro
books.description: A short metaphysical treatise on fundamental questions about being and essence. A useful bridge to understanding Thomistic philosophical language.
books.question: What is the difference between what a thing is and the fact that it exists?
books.whyRead: To enter Thomistic metaphysics through a relatively short text and build a more rigorous vocabulary for discussing being, essence and existence.

books.title: Apologia de Sócrates
books.author: Platão
books.description: A philosophical account of Socrates's defense before the city of Athens. The work was written by Plato: Socrates left no known writings of his own.
books.question: Why can defending philosophy put someone in conflict with the city?
books.whyRead: To reflect on intellectual courage, examining one's own life and conflicts between conviction and authority through a founding dialogue of Western philosophy.

books.title: Críton
books.author: Platão
books.description: A dialogue in which Socrates discusses duty, justice and obedience to the law when he could escape from prison.
books.question: Are there times when obeying the law is part of justice?
books.whyRead: To think through the conflict between legal obligation and conscience, comparing the dialogue's arguments with present-day moral and legal dilemmas.

books.title: Fédon
books.author: Platão
books.description: A dialogue set in Socrates' final hours, debating the soul, death and the practice of philosophy.
books.question: What do the arguments about the soul reveal about the philosophical life?
books.whyRead: To follow a philosophical discussion of the soul, death and the meaning of the examined life, distinguishing Plato's arguments from our own beliefs.

books.title: A República
books.author: Platão
books.description: A philosophical dialogue investigating justice, education, forms of government and the organization of the city, with Socrates as the central interlocutor.
books.question: What would a just city look like, and who should govern it?
books.whyRead: To study Plato's questions about justice, education, virtue and the organization of the city, even when one disagrees with his political answers.

books.title: Democracia: o Deus que Falhou
books.author: Hans-Hermann Hoppe
books.query: Democracia o Deus que Falhou Hans Hermann Hoppe livro
books.description: A libertarian critique of representative democracy and a theoretical comparison of incentives under monarchy, democracy and private-property orders. The conclusions are positions the author defends.
books.question: How would different regimes change the incentives of those who govern?
books.whyRead: To get to know a controversial critique of democratic institutions and examine it against opposing arguments, distinguishing historical diagnosis, theory and normative judgments.

books.title: Uma Teoria do Socialismo e do Capitalismo
books.author: Hans-Hermann Hoppe
books.query: Uma Teoria do Socialismo e do Capitalismo Hans Hermann Hoppe livro
books.description: An overview of the author's economic and political typology, centered on private property, state intervention and ethical implications.
books.question: How does the definition of private property affect the classification of economic systems?
books.whyRead: To compare the economic categories and the arguments on property and social coordination that Hoppe presents with alternative economic perspectives.

books.title: A Economia e a Ética da Propriedade Privada
books.author: Hans-Hermann Hoppe
books.query: A Economia e a Ética da Propriedade Privada Hans Hermann Hoppe livro
books.description: A collection of essays in economics and philosophy on taxation, economic theory, property rights and the ethical foundations of libertarianism.
books.question: Can property rights be justified through ethical arguments?
books.whyRead: To explore a philosophical defense of private property and study its assumptions, objections and implications without mistaking the author's position for academic consensus.

books.title: As Seis Lições
books.author: Ludwig von Mises
books.query: As Seis Lições Ludwig von Mises LVM Editora livro
books.description: An introduction to the Austrian School, gathering lectures on capitalism, socialism, interventionism, inflation, foreign investment and politics. A gateway to Mises's ideas.
books.question: What changes when we look at the economic consequences of state intervention?
books.whyRead: For an introductory look at concepts of markets, money, inflation and state intervention in the Austrian tradition, complemented by reading from other schools of economics.

books.title: Ação Humana: Um Tratado de Economia
books.author: Ludwig von Mises
books.query: Ação Humana Um Tratado de Economia Ludwig von Mises livro
books.description: A treatise on economics that presents praxeology and discusses individual choice, prices, money, economic calculation and how markets work. A long and more advanced read.
books.question: How do individual choices and incentives produce economic phenomena?
books.whyRead: For those who want to systematically study Mises's arguments on action, prices and economic calculation; a dense work, best suited to sustained reading.
